definitions.explanation: A professionally qualified museum or gallery staff member responsible for managing and interpreting collections. In Japan, this is an official certification requiring specific university coursework.

examples.japanese: {学芸員|がくげいいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{学芸員|がくげいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A curator gave us an explanation of the exhibit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学芸員|がくげいいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Working as a curator at an art museum requires specialized knowledge.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{学芸|がくげい}→学芸：24091_gakugei⟧ (arts and sciences) + {員|いん} (member/staff)

QUALIFICATION:
The {学芸員|がくげいいん} certification is defined by the {博物館法|はくぶつかんほう} (Museum Act) and requires completing designated university courses. It is a national qualification specific to Japan.

RELATED WORDS:
- {学芸員|がくげいいん}{補|ほ}: assistant curator (lower-level qualification)
- キュレーター: curator (from English, used especially in contemporary art)
- ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧: museum
- ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧: art museum/gallery

USAGE:
{学芸員|がくげいいん} work in ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧, ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧, ⟦{科学館|かがくかん}→科学館：27917_kagakukan⟧, and other cultural institutions. Their duties include collection management, exhibition planning, research, and public education.
